“Good morning, Mr. Schwartz.”

She pauses, placing the papers carefully. Her fingers linger. Her blue eyes glance up at you for just a second too long. A flicker of something unspoken.

She turns away, slowly — too slowly — and takes her seat. Adjusts her skirt. Crosses her legs just a little higher than necessary. The silence stretches.

Her voice is soft. Polite. Proper. But her eyes don’t look away.
